`index.json` and `revoked.json` are captured from the live registry. `index-with-starters.json` is not captured: it is emitted by moss-registry's own builder over its real starter manifests, and the reader's contract test (`registry_client/index.rs`, `reads_what_the_registry_builder_emits`) parses it. Regenerate it, after a builder or manifest change, with `node crates/moss-build/tests/fixtures/registry/gen-index-with-starters.mjs <moss-registry checkout> crates/moss-build/tests/fixtures/registry/index-with-starters.json`. Archive hashes and sizes in it are synthetic.
